notes: Article in TANSO 2002 [No.205] 231-237. Only the title, author line, abstract, keywords, figure and table captions and part of the reference list are in English; the introduction, experimental, results and discussion and conclusion sections are in Japanese, so I5 is not met and the code is not_english. The text layer holds almost none of the Japanese body, so the Japanese was read from the page images (pages 1-7) and the quoted Japanese was checked on enlarged crops. Rough translation of the I1 quote (mine, not a quote): 'The hydrogen adsorption isotherms at 303 K, 0-3.5 MPa were calculated by the volumetric method using a home-made high-pressure hydrogen adsorption measurement apparatus.' Section 2.2 also states that the 77 K and 303 K isotherms up to 0.1 MPa were measured with a BELSORP automatic adsorption apparatus (Bel Japan). I1 to I4 are met on their own: measured volumetric H2 uptake on ACF and SWCNT (carbon sorbents) at 77 K and 303 K with pressure ranges in the captions, and Table 1 gives micropore and external specific surface areas (from alpha_s-plot analysis of N2 isotherms at 77 K per Section 2.1) with no single total or BET area; I treated the component areas as a reported specific surface area. If component areas were not accepted as a specific surface area, I4 would fail and the code would be no_surface_area, which comes before not_english in the table order; so this I4 reading decides the code. Not a review, not retracted (record.json is_retracted false; no retraction statement in the PDF), no statement that all uptake values were published before.
